I have successfully investigated and resolved the bug preventing Gemini Extensions from being installed via SSH-based repository sources.

### Cause of the Bug
When an extension is installed using a remote source, the extension manager (`packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts`) parses the URL via `tryParseGithubUrl` to determine if it is a GitHub repository. 
If identified as a GitHub repository (even if configured utilizing SSH protocols such as `git@github.com:owner/repo.git` or `ssh://git@github.com/owner/repo.git`), the manager would mistakenly request a source zip/tarball download from the GitHub Release endpoints over HTTP (`https`).

This process fails for SSH URLs because:
1. SSH URLs explicitly request standard Git clone authentication with SSH keys.
2. HTTP requests do not utilize local SSH identities/keys, failing access to private or restricted repositories.
3. In headless/non-interactive sandbox environments, prompts that ask the user to fall back to `git clone` fail automatically.

### Implemented Solution
1. **Source Detection**: Modified the installation flow in [packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/small_triaged_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_26273/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts) to detect whether a source URL uses SSH:
   - Starts with SCP-style `git@`
   - Starts with standard SSH scheme `ssh://`
   - Starts with alternative SSH scheme `git+ssh://`
2. **Standard Git Clone Bypassing**: When an SSH URL is detected, the manager skips attempting to download via GitHub releases, setting the type directly to `git`, and executing standard local cloning through `cloneFromGit()`. This naturally and cleanly utilizes the system's SSH keys and configurations.
3. **Automatic Git-based Updates**: When an extension's install metadata type is `git`, it correctly checks updates using the git client (`git.listRemote` and `git.revparse`), supporting subsequent updates cleanly.

### Unit Tests Added
Added comprehensive unit test suites within [packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.test.ts](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/small_triaged_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_26273/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.test.ts):
- Test asserting that installations with SCP-style SSH sources (`git@github.com:owner/ssh-ext.git`) directly call `cloneFromGit` instead of `downloadFromGitHubRelease`.
- Test asserting that installations with standard SSH URLs (`ssh://git@github.com/owner/ssh-ext-2.git`) similarly execute standard client-side `cloneFromGit`.

All `extension-manager.test.ts` unit tests and `github.test.ts` (34 tests) pass with zero errors. All changes remain staged in the repository.
